target_subject: one person surfing on a wave in an artificial channel

scene: Turbulent greenish water with white foam breaking over a submerged structure, bordered by a dark concrete bank lined with soil and sparse vegetation.
A narrow, man-made water channel with visible concrete edges and a sloped earthen embankment under low ambient light.
Daytime conditions indicated by natural lighting on the surfer and wave, with no artificial illumination evident.
action: The person crouches low on a surfboard, left hand extended toward the water surface, right arm bent at the elbow for balance.
The surfer maintains forward momentum along the face of a breaking wave, with spray trailing behind the board’s tail.
Feet are positioned on the board: left foot near the center, right foot near the tail, both bare and gripping the deck.
rationale: The presence of a straight concrete edge and uniform wave shape suggests an engineered wave pool rather than natural ocean surf.
The lighting pattern—bright on subject, dark elsewhere—implies natural daylight rather than artificial illumination, as no visible light sources are present.
The surfer’s wetsuit has visible logos (e.g., a stylized 'A' on chest), but specific brand names are unreadable due to motion blur and resolution.
object: A person wearing a full-length black-and-teal wetsuit with long sleeves and visible seams, standing barefoot on a surfboard.
The surfboard is predominantly white with blue and gray graphics near the tail; its nose points leftward and is partially submerged in whitewater.
Water exhibits churning turbulence with distinct crests and troughs, indicating high flow velocity and hydraulic forcing.
The concrete bank runs parallel to the wave direction and shows signs of wear, including minor cracks and accumulated debris.
A circular object with a white rim and dark center is partially visible in the upper-right corner, possibly a sign or equipment cover, but its function is indeterminate.
